ordered_diagnoses: Undifferentiated Embryonal Sarcoma of the Liver

facts.raw_span: An 8-year-old girl weighing 44.5 kg
no significant medical history
a 1-week history of progressive abdominal pain, distension, nausea, and vomiting
notable abdominal distension without guarding or rebound
a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe with compression of the inferior vena cava (IVC)
worsening abdominal distension and concern for abdominal compartment syndrome
persistent sanguineous output from the drain led to anemia and concern for hemorrhage
an infrarenal IVC thrombus and a near-occlusive embolus in the left pulmonary artery
compression of the distal IVC at its junction with the right atrium
otherwise normal biventricular function and no evidence of elevated right heart pressures
